name: Foundry: First Pour
design_intent:
FOUNDRY: FIRST POUR — THE FOUNDRY circuit's crusher ON-RAMP (tier 1; brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 Foundry row 5). A single VERTICAL stamping press on the center island B of the validated flagship three-island / one-void shape (mirrors foundry_press_row but ONE press, not two, with a LONGER open dwell and a NARROW head = the gentlest possible introduction to the mechanic). The press hammers straight DOWN onto B on a slow readable rhythm; the safe beat is a long open dwell with the head parked HIGH, and B's LEFT edge, RIGHT edge and both flanking islands are permanent refuges. Single-family (crusher only), lowest Foundry tier.

DOCTRINE FIT: (1) LETHAL — the descending head instakills on contact via kill(&ring_out); no shove/hitstun (same path as press_row). (2) TELEGRAPHY — a long ~2.3s OPEN DWELL (head parked at center ~y740, well above a standing player's head) then a windup SHUDDER + hazard-red FLASH for telegraph_lead 0.6s BEFORE a fast ~0.34s slam (period_s 3.4). (3) FAIRNESS — the head is NARROW (head_w 160 -> lethal band x~1950..2110); B's LEFT edge (x1580..1950) and RIGHT edge (x2110..2480) are ALWAYS clear standing refuges, and islands A/C are permanent hazard-free refuges. Boosting UP above the parked head also clears a slam. NO player spawns on B (spawns on A/C only). (4) CREDIT — a press kill with no attacker = uncredited self-fall (killer=-1); a rival who knocked the victim under the press within the 6.0s ring-out window is credited; the press never sets last_attacker.

GEOMETRY (symmetric flagship void_is_floor): three flat trampoline islands over ONE full-width void: A x0..900 top1080 / B x1580..2480 top1080 (the PRESS, center x2030) / C x3160..4060 top1080, separated by 680px void gaps. Bounds -610..4670 x, top -2090, bottom 1878 (>=650px recovery sky; outer edges 610px inside side blast lines). Molten open_sky (clouds off, horizon glow) = a smelting works.

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP (flight-required; Tuning: trampoline apex 270px => ~395px zero-boost drift; max spring drift ~527px; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680px in ~0.9-1.0s):
- GAP A<->B (island edges x900..x1580 = 680px over void): > 527 (max spring drift) and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (island edges x2480..x3160 = 680px over void): identical. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- DODGE the press on B: shuffle to a clear edge on the long open beat, or boost up above the parked head; a mistimed stand under a slam = instant off-screen kill. Verb: DODGE (+ TIME).
- Zero-boost off any island reaches NO other surface across a 680px gap: flight is REQUIRED; the press reshapes/times the fight on B, it never creates a bounce path across a gap and leaves the island edges + A/C clear.

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT: the gentlest single-press on-ramp (foundry_press_row runs TWO offset presses; this is ONE with a longer dwell). One-line read: 'time one dash under the pile-driver, or knock a rival beneath it.'
